requirements.description: User wants the property near public transport. Value set to the 75th percentile (70.93, rounded to 71) of the mobility distribution.
A university student residence needs to be close to universities and schools. Value set to the 75th percentile (75.14, rounded to 75) of the education distribution.
Energy class C or better (A1 through C), as explicitly requested by the user.

The user explicitly requires at least 850 sqm of gross floor area, so surface_area is filtered with a >= threshold. The 60-person capacity is not converted into an area filter because no verified gross-area threshold was supplied by the RegulatoryAgent. The future student-residence use does not affect the current typology. The Turin location and public-transport preference are handled by other agents, and the energy-class requirement is outside the reference columns.

output.explanation: Filters on office-type properties with surface_area >= 850, within 3.0 km of the given coordinates, energy class A1-C, mobility score >= 71 and education score >= 75. Results are ordered by distance from the coordinates. Capacity (60 people) and the CDP/PNRR program are not in the extracted requirements, so no predicate was added for them.
